actions.tables-clear-table.description: Delete all records from a table.
actions.tables-create-records.descriptio: Insert one or more new records into a table.
actions.tables-create-records.props.reco: Array of objects keyed by field name. Overrides the form above.
actions.tables-create-records.props.valu: One entry per record to insert.
actions.tables-create-table.description: Create a new table, optionally with fields.
actions.tables-create-table.props.fields: The columns to create. Leave empty to create a table with no fields.
actions.tables-delete-record.props.recor: Usually mapped from a Find Records step or a table trigger.
actions.tables-delete-table.description: Delete a table and all of its records.
actions.tables-download-table.descriptio: Export a table as a CSV file.
actions.tables-download-table.props.incl: Adds the column names as the first row of the CSV.
actions.tables-find-records.description: Find records in a table with filters.
actions.tables-find-records.props.filter: All conditions must match. Empty returns every record.
Maximum records to return. Empty returns all records.
actions.tables-get-record.description: Get a single record by its ID.
actions.tables-get-record.props.record_i: Usually comes from a Find Records step or a table trigger.
actions.tables-update-record.description: Update values in an existing record.
actions.tables-update-record.props.empty: Empty fields keep their current value.
actions.tables-update-record.props.recor: Usually comes from a Find Records step or a table trigger.
actions.tables-update-record.props.value: Leave a field empty to keep its current value.
triggers.deletedRecord.description: Triggers when a record is deleted from the selected table.
triggers.newRecord.description: Triggers when a new record is added to the selected table.
triggers.updatedRecord.description: Triggers when a record is updated in the selected table.
